content.short: Moralis Unity SDK enables wallet and blockchain integration for Unity games.
content.description: Moralis Unity SDK enables Unity game developers to leverage a complete web3 backend to build games that interact with decentralized protocols. It extends a broad development platform dedicated to creating and supporting web3 applications, providing secure, efficient integration of blockchain features and NFTs directly into Unity projects. With this SDK, developers can manage user wallets, real-time data, asset ownership, and on-chain interactions from within Unity, streamlining the creation of blockchain-enabled gameplay experiences.
